title: Yours Truly, a Max x20 User
description:
Anthropic, this has to stop.

Every day it's something new. Credits here, credits there. Weekly credits. Sonnet, Opus, Fable. Five-hour limits. Weekly limits.

Miss one morning check and I don't even know the rules anymore.

We just wanna pay you and work. That's it.

I know compute is expensive. That's your problem to solve, not ours to stress over.

Does this get better or worse from here? Comment below and hit the poll.
